user.title: Personas Studio
user.description: Three channels, three destinations: the conversation waits for an answer, life events and feedback are sent without waiting for one.

data_description.url: Endpoint or base of the conversation channel (conversation entity, synchronous). A URL WITHOUT a path (http://127.0.0.1:8080) gets /webhook/<persona> appended; a URL WITH a path is used as is.
data_description.persona: Persona that answers. Ignored when the URL already has a path.
data_description.token: Bearer token sent to this channel. Empty = no Authorization header.
data_description.event_url: Endpoint of personas_home.send_event. Empty = same URL as the conversation.
data_description.event_persona: Persona that receives the events. Ignored when the URL already has a path.
data_description.event_token: Bearer token sent to this channel. Empty = no header. Never inherited from another channel.
data_description.feedback_url: Endpoint of personas_home.send_feedback (notifications and repairs). Empty = same URL as the conversation.
data_description.feedback_persona: Persona that receives the feedback. Ignored when the URL already has a path.
data_description.feedback_token: Bearer token sent to this channel. Empty = no header. Never inherited from another channel.

error.wrong_endpoint: The host answers but refuses this endpoint. A URL WITHOUT a path gets /webhook/<persona> appended; a URL WITH a path is sent as is — check which of the two shapes is expected.
error.tls_failed: TLS failed: invalid certificate or unexpected host. This is not a passing outage; the URL is not saved.

abort.already_configured: This conversation URL and persona are already configured.

persona_timeout.message: The persona did not answer in time.

persona_unreachable.message: The persona cannot be reached right now.

send_event.name: Send an event
send_event.description: Sends a life event, as free text, on the events channel (does not block the automation, no answer expected). To get an answer, use the conversation entity, which talks to another destination.

text.name: Text
text.description: The content or event passed on to the persona.

persona.name: Persona
persona.description: Target persona (by default the one of the events channel). No effect when the channel URL is a complete endpoint: it already names its recipient. The case is then reported in the log.

send_feedback.name: Send feedback about an entity
send_feedback.description: Sends structured feedback about a Home Assistant entity, without waiting for an answer, on the feedback channel: notifications and repairs.

entity_id.name: Entity
entity_id.description: What the feedback is about. Not necessarily an entity of the registry: the identifier of a persistent notification or of a repair issue works too.

event_type.name: Event type
event_type.description: Kind of feedback, on the studio side.

accepted.name: Accepted
accepted.description: Whether the feedback is positive (default yes).

suggestion_id.name: Suggestion identifier
suggestion_id.description: Suggestion targeted on the studio side (default latest).

persona.name: Persona
persona.description: Target persona (by default the one of the feedback channel). No effect when the channel URL is a complete endpoint: it already names its recipient. The case is then reported in the log.
